summary.headline: Astrological Interrogations 43–57
summary.text: Astrological interrogations 43–57 on war, appointments, royal audiences, authority, land, rumors, journeys, absent persons, timing, garments, objects held in the hand, star colors and smells, sleeping, drugs, and a ship’s inception, with cross-references to Theophilus, Valens, and several codices.
